# `connectors`

Generated by `connectors-docs` from the two definitions the `connectors` binary parses: the command tree that ESS generates from the CLI binding [`apps/connectors/spec/cli.yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/blob/main/apps/connectors/spec/cli.yaml), and the explicit service commands in [`apps/connectors/src/compat.rs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/blob/main/apps/connectors/src/compat.rs). It lists only commands that exist. `connectors --version` prints the version, and `--help` after any command prints its usage.

> Local integration access through explicitly configured adapters

## Global options

Every grouped command accepts these, anywhere on the command line.

| Argument | Required | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--config <global_config>` | no | none | any |  |
| `--state-dir <global_state>` | no | none | any |  |
| `--output <global_output>` | no | `human` | `human`, `json` |  |

## Explicit service commands

These talk to an adapter service or a federation host over HTTP instead of the local owner. They accept `--output` for parse refusals only; a successful result is the service's JSON.

## `connectors describe`

Read a complete service descriptor

```text
connectors describe [OPTIONS] --endpoint <ENDPOINT> --token-file <TOKEN_FILE>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>` | yes | none | any |  |
| `--token-file <TOKEN_FILE>` | yes | none | any |  |
| `--allow-plaintext` | no | `false` | any |  |

## `connectors invoke`

Invoke an explicit service operation

```text
connectors invoke [OPTIONS] --endpoint <ENDPOINT> --token-file <TOKEN_FILE> --operation <OPERATION> --input <INPUT>
```

| Argument | Required | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>` | yes | none | any |  |
| `--token-file <TOKEN_FILE>` | yes | none | any |  |
| `--allow-plaintext` | no | `false` | any |  |
| `--operation <OPERATION>` | yes | none | any |  |
| `--input <INPUT>` | yes | none | any |  |
